title: SAGE Edge Type Registry
description: Per-vault registry assigning a resolution_policy to every edge type used by the vault. Consulted at edge creation (write-time invariant enforcement) and at traversal (chain-scoped resolution). Frozen per-edge at creation: the policy value is copied onto the edge row so later registry edits do not retroactively change resolution behavior for existing edges. See CAS-ADR-017.

entries.description: Registry entries. Every edge type that appears in the vault's graph must have an entry. Entries for unused edge types are permitted.

edge_type.description: The edge type whose resolution policy is being declared.

resolution_policy.description: How chain-scoped resolution treats edges of this type. `none`: meta-edge / lineage fact, no propagation; `transitive_source`: source anchor must be in source endpoint's lineage, target is frozen at derivation (no target anchor); `transitive_target`: mirror of transitive_source — target anchor must be in target endpoint's lineage, source is frozen at derivation (no source anchor); `transitive_both`: both anchors participate in lineage resolution; `TBD`: policy not yet frozen, write-time creation is rejected.

notes.description: Optional free-text explanation of the policy choice.
